title: Reject zero TDMA slot counts instead of panicking
description: P2 correctness/API invariant: rust/lichen-node/src/tdma_scheduler.rs TdmaScheduler::slot_for computes modulo num_slots as u32 without validating num_slots. The public API accepts u16, so slot_for(..., 0) panics from division by zero in production/no_std callers. Change the API to return a validation error (or enforce a NonZeroU16/validated configuration), update all callers, and add zero/boundary/vector tests. Also replace stale integration helpers in ccp_beacon_format.rs and sfn_wrap_vectors.rs with calls to the production TdmaScheduler so canonical FNV1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN) modulo N vectors actually test the implementation.
close_reason: All bead requirements were already satisfied in the tree (landed under 95d85c3747): slot_for validates num_slots==0 -> Err(ZeroSlots) (tdma_scheduler.rs:18-24), zero/boundary/vector tests exist (zero_slots_is_rejected unit test + ccp_beacon_format.rs:72 zero_slot_schedule_is_rejected), and both integration files drive the production TdmaScheduler::slot_for with canonical FNV1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN) mod N vectors — no stale local helpers remain. Only actual gap: stale header comment at sfn_wrap_vectors.rs:104 claiming tests use an 'expected implementation until Rust is fixed' — corrected to state they drive the production scheduler. 22/22 tests pass (19 sfn_wrap_vectors + 3 ccp_beacon_format). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS (panic path unreachable; Result forces future callers to handle ZeroSlots), edge-cases PASS with 1 latent finding filed as new P3 bead (test-oracle u32 overflow, non-triggering).
